facts.text: The stage position is kept in micrometres for x, y and z and in degrees for alpha and beta
A stage x move is refused when the absolute x value exceeds 1000 um
A stage y move is refused when the absolute y value exceeds 1000 um
A stage z move is refused when the absolute z value exceeds 375 um
A stage alpha tilt is refused when the absolute alpha value exceeds 80 degrees
A stage beta tilt is refused when the absolute beta value exceeds 29.7 degrees
The stage speed is a fraction of the standard speed, clamped to 0.00032 at the low end and 1.0 at the high end
reset_stage_position sets x, y, z, alpha and beta to zero
stage_is_home compares every axis against the home position with a default threshold of 0.1
make_safe closes the column valve, blanks the beam and inserts the fluorescent screen
get_column_vacuum and get_accelerator_vacuum return a log value or a pressure in pascals
The column valve position is 'open' or 'closed'
The fluorescent screen position is 'retracted' or 'inserted'
beam_is_blank reports whether the beam is blanked
The instrument mode is TEM or STEM
The projection mode is imaging or diffraction
The illumination mode is nanoprobe or microprobe
